I didn't find any documentation for an `npx agents init` command, so I can't confirm that it exists. The current docs describe two other ways to get started.

**1. New project from a starter template.** The Cloudflare docs' quick start uses the create-cloudflare CLI with the agents starter template, then installs dependencies and starts the dev server. Run `npm create cloudflare@latest -- --template cloudflare/agents-starter`, then `cd agents-starter`, `npm install`, and `npm run dev`. The template also gives you a server file, a React client, a Wrangler config, and a Vite config with the agents plugin (per the same page, src/server.ts for agent code, src/client.tsx for the React frontend).

**2. Building a Worker from scratch.** The AI Search guide starts with a new Worker project using the create-cloudflare CLI (C3), with prompts for the template, language, and git. It then has you run `npm i agents @cloudflare/ai-chat ai workers-ai-provider zod` to install the SDK and related packages.

**3. Adding to an existing Workers project.** Install the package with `npm i agents`. The guide lists prerequisites of an existing Cloudflare Workers project with a Wrangler configuration file and Node.js 18 or newer.

The package was renamed from `agents-sdk` to `agents` in March 2025. The older package has been marked as deprecated. If you see `agents-sdk` in older tutorials, use `agents` instead.

If you were thinking of a specific `npx agents` command, it may be from a tool or version I didn't find. Tell me where you saw it and I can search again.

content.text:
I couldn't find an `npx agents init` command anywhere. Cloudflare's Agents docs don't list it, the shared lessons database had nothing on it, and two web searches turned up nothing. Unless you saw it somewhere specific, I'd assume it doesn't exist. The documented way to start a new project is the `create-cloudflare` starter template.

## New project (recommended)

```bash
npm create cloudflare@latest -- --template cloudflare/agents-starter
cd agents-starter
npm install
npm run dev
```

This gives you:
- `src/server.ts`: your agent code
- `src/client.tsx`: a React chat frontend
- a Wrangler config and a Vite config with the agents plugin already set up

## Adding the SDK to an existing Workers project

```bash
npm i agents
```

You need an existing Worker with a Wrangler config file and Node.js 18 or newer. If you're building a chat agent, the AI Search guide also installs `@cloudflare/ai-chat ai workers-ai-provider zod`.

The package was renamed from `agents-sdk` to `agents` in March 2025, and `agents-sdk` is deprecated. If an older tutorial uses `agents-sdk`, install `agents` instead.

You might be thinking of `npx skills add https://github.com/cloudflare/skills`, which has a similar name. It installs Cloudflare agent skills into coding tools and doesn't scaffold a project. If you saw `npx agents init` in a particular place, send me the link and I'll look into it.

Sources:
- [Agents quick start](https://77b1402b.previews.developers.cloudflare.com/agents/getting-started/quick-start/)
- [Add to existing project](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/getting-started/add-to-existing-project/index.md)
- [Changelog: npm i agents](https://developers.cloudflare.com/changelog/post/2025-03-18-npm-i-agents/index.md)
- [AI Search: Agents SDK](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-search/agent-sdks/agents-sdk/)
- [Changelog: Agents SDK launch](https://developers.cloudflare.com/changelog/2025-02-25-agents-sdk/)
- [Cloudflare skills (mdskills)](https://www.mdskills.ai/de/skills/agents-sdk)
